case.state: You think you can handle the heat!? Well then, come play with fire, boys!
I've been waiting for my chance to just let go and have some fun.
Finally, a moment to indulge myself without someone nagging in my ears.
Time for some quality adult time~
What's wrong? Cat got your tongue?
I don't like the feeling that knight is giving off.
This is a joke, right? A butterfly? That talks?
Don't start crying when I inevitably win.
Let's see if you have what it takes to stand against the Witch of Immolation!
Hmmm... I'll change ~cards.ifplural(these|this)~ ~cards.text~.
~Cards.text~ seems about right.
Guess I should change ~cards.ifplural(these|this)~ ~cards.text~.
I want to switch ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~.
~Cards.text~ please.
Oooh dealer, give me ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~ please.
~Cards.text~ should do the trick!
Ahahaha! Let's see if any of you can keep up against the Big V.
I'll warn you, this isn't my first poker game.
Things are about to heat up.
I'd suggest you start thinking about what you're going to take off next~
Now, no whining when I kick your sorry asses, alright?
Betting for money wouldn't have been half bad right now.
I make this look easy!
This hand is just, mwah.
Fufufu~ Perfect.
This is the first time I'm playing strip poker. Be sure to leave a lasting impression.
No one can stand against the might of the Crimson Flame!
Ahahahaha!
And Lady Claire keeps saying that being risky doesn't pay off
Give me everything you've got!
I'm on fire!
Who's next on the barbeque?
I just might be too much to handle~
It's exhausting to have tits this great.
Feeling the heat rise yet?
Got a pair on your mind?
Will I win? Will I lose? Either way, I'm having a blast!
Think you can beat me? Ha! Think again.
You can never keep me down for long.
One mistake and I'll suddenly turn the tables on you.
I know a couple of guys that would kill to see me like this.
It's a lot more exciting to play with our dignity on the line instead of money, wouldn't you agree? ~player~?
What did I get? We'll just have to wait and see, won't we?
What is life without a little risk?
I hope I didn't overfeed Gul and Gal. But I just can't say no to their cute puppy eyes.
Let's see if any of you are brave enough to stand up against me.
Going for pairs is for losers.
Hmmm... I wonder if the other witches could be convinced to join me one of these days.
Let's see if this gamble paid off.
I've got this in the bag; I'm sure someone else has worse than me.
Without uncertainty, the world would be boring, wouldn't you agree?
I kind of like how simple these poker rules are. It makes it easy to focus on more... important things.
Hmmm... what should I strip next?
Should I give a little sneak peek?
I hardly mind if I win or lose. Either I get to see all of you touch yourselves for my amusement, or I get to touch myself and release some stress.
I'm sure someone else has worse.
Oh? How exciting.
I've still got plenty left to lose; I'll be fine either way.
I could use this time to brush my hair, given how slow some of you all are.
If you don't like your cards, then for the price of one shot of whiskey, I can burn them for you and get you new ones.
The uncertainty makes it more fun.
Damn, I'm hot.
Won't anyone throw the round for poor little me?
Will you get to see more of me? Or do I grasp the clutches of victory before your very eyes?
Excited for what happens next, ~player~?
Gambling is the most fun when you have something to lose.
Win or lose, either way I'll get what I want.
I can only wait and see what's going to happen next.
Before anyone asks, yes, I could use magic to make myself luckier. No, I won't be using it; I have too much pride to be lowering myself to cheating in a poker game.
Despite the title as the Witch of Immolation, using fire isn't the only magic I can do. But I won't tell you what other magic I have. It's a lady's secret.
What's a lady to do to get a drink around here?
Ugh, really? This is my first hand?
Sigh, it's going to be one of those games.
This better not be an omen.
I have an awful feeling about how this will end for me.
...I could use a drink.
I might as well start undressing right now!
Just my luck...
At least I get to show off more.
Having power really doesn't mean much when you're at the whim of Lady Luck.
Hmmmm...
I can make this work. I've been dealt worse.
No problem; I can handle this.
Someone wants me to get naked quickly.
Crap, should have done something different.
Maybe that last night out hit me harder than I thought.
I deserve better than this!
Tsk!
Did I make a mistake somewhere? How did I end up with such a crappy hand?
Whatever. In the end, this game is all luck-based.
I can almost hear the lecture one of the witches would want to give me right now. Complaining that I gamble too much.
You have to be willing to be risky; nothing gets done if you don't throw yourself out there.
Will I win? Will I lose? You'll have to wait and see.
I can't believe this... I screwed up.
Oh, you've got to be kidding me.
And there comes lady luck with a strap-on, just to fuck me over.
I might as well start touching myself at this rate.
Ha! It seems I finally found something I'm not good at.
Ugh! I should have played this better.
Torn between blaming luck or blaming myself for this horrible hand.
At least take me out for dinner first before fucking me over like this!
Why am I not surprised?
Fortune favors the bold, my ass!
Who knew the cat lady would be a sly fox in disguise.
Impressive; it must have taken you a long time to master the art of transmogrifying.
What a lovely sunny day! I should have brought my bikini with me.
I could lie down in this sun forever.
Whoever decided that we should play outside where the sun shines, it was a fantastic idea.
I'm keeping an eye on you, Beatrix. I have yet to meet a scientist that wasn't morally corrupt.
I appreciate the honesty~
If I burn your cards, are you really still a duelist?
I wonder if they sell martinis here.
Hmm... I wonder if they sell sex on the beach here.
Someone has some big ideas after the game I see, hoping to bed one of us? ~player~?
Who suggested we should be playing in this old and cursed forest? The moment I see any undead awaken from their grave, I'll burn down this entire forest.
Hehehe, good luck.
I'd suggest giving up this round; you're not beating me.
Just my luck to have to play with a machine...
I'm watching you closely, ~angel~. Don't do something you'll regret.
I'm keeping an eye on you, ~angel~. The moment you start talking about how great your god is, expect a flaming orb of pain your way!
You get one chance, ~angel~. Normally I'd toast an angel the moment I see them. So don't waste this opportunity.
It's the final round! This is what it all comes down too, kid. Come at me!
I can never tell with types like ~scientist~ if they are well-meaning geniuses or delusional idiots.
It seems we are all evenly matched, which means it all comes down to these last few hands to determine the winner. Come at me!
There is no stopping the Witch of Immolation!
Just you and me, ~Other~. You've been a worthy challenger so far, but this is where I claim my victory.
You've done well lasting this long against me, ~Other~. Let's see if you got what it takes to beat me!
But... lingering on this any longer isn't fun for any of us. I won't push the subject any further.
Go on, ~player~. Give my behind a big smooch~
Like, don't you have some nuts and bolts to touch yourself to?
What kind of things would a machine even show me? Fake tits? A plastic penis?
And who's to say that they won't just cheat? With some kind of... cheat vision.
I know my breasts are my best attribute, but I'd say I've got a pretty nice butt as well.
I've decided to give you all a little bit of a treat. By showing my other good side.
I do think my butt is underappreciated. And so are my legs.
I'm a picture-perfect view, no matter what side you look at.
I've had men fight over who would get to have me on their lap. It's never any of them, but I appreciate the gesture.
That... didn't pay off.
How did I screw up that badly?
...Hmph.
Can't I just burn these cards?
...I'm sure this is fine.
Could I really not get anything better?
Guess I better start thinking about what I'll take off next.
Who will win? And who will join the losers side? I can hardly wait.

Of course we're real; we witches are the natural protectors of this planet, and we make sure that humanity isn't ruining it with their greed. Having to scare a child here or there is a bonus; it helps remind them to be good to the world.
Awww, what's wrong, scrap metal? Can't handle the idea that I'm better than you? Humans can't build something that could surpass a witch's allure.

It took you long enough to realize, but yes. I'm a witch, though we share some similarities with humans. We are born from the power of Mother Lapistier. A powerful rune that keeps the balance in the world. She creates us when the world is in danger.
Can't be perfect in everything, hun. Besides, this game is a good part luck anyway; there is nothing you can do about it. You'd think a machine would understand that.
Same reason as you, Reploid. To relax, saving the world from greedy humans is a full-time job and can be very frustrating.
You'd be correct in that assumption. We very much could mate with human males. But unless they are special, they won't ever be attractive to a witch.
Alright, what's the big deal with you disliking big tits? What's not to love about them? Don't tell me you're genuinely jealous of people that have them

We are different in the same way you're different from a human; you're mechanical; they are flesh; witches are beings created by magic that have flesh, while humans are just flesh. We look alike but have nothing else in common other than how our bodies look.
I wouldn't really call us a team, as much as we were simply born for the same purpose. I work better on my own.
Only if it's truly necessary. Together we're all powerful, but I prefer working alone most of the time.
I find that hard to believe, given there are only nine witches in the world right now. And they would have told me if they encountered someone like you.
It sets a good precedent for who I am as a person and why you should watch out that you don't anger me.
Hey! These are not loud clothes; they are there to simply amplify how amazing my figure is.
Given that everyone constantly wants to oogle me, I'd say it feels just fine.
Oh, I love it. I make those kinds of jokes all the time. It's a fun way to express myself, and I get complimented to boot.

You want the real truth? I think a lot of them are idiots. Rarely do I meet worthwhile humans that are deserving of genuine respect. I know this sounds harsh to say to another human, but if you've looked around you once or twice, you understand what I mean.
You're anything but a mere human, boy. Don't start getting cocky with me before you've won.
Oh, shut it, you. Of course I wanted to win, but I also came here to enjoy myself and relax; if I win, it's fun because I won; if I lose, it'll be fun to do something a little bit... daring.
What's wrong with making sure that everyone knows what they are getting themselves into? It perfectly sets the tone of what kind of lady I am.
Nothing wrong with making sure people know how I am as a person. Preparing them to not get burned.
Are journalists usually this arrogant?
Does arrogance run in the journalism business? Or are you always this arrogant?
Correct, my sisters and I all control their own respective magic, mine being linked to the passion of the flame.
Can't say that I've heard that name before; I'm assuming they're a handsome lady who uses fire?
Sorry, but I've never heard that name before. I assume they're a skilled fire magic user?
You're a bold one, aren't you? Asking a lady you just met to honor such a request.
Oh? What's wrong? Hoping that my tits will pop out? I know what I got, and I'm not afraid to show it off.

I wouldn't call myself a heroic adventurer or anything like that. What I would call myself is a natural disaster that will bring peace to the earth, for when humanity does something stupid again, one fireball at a time.
From time to time, when they have too much to drink and think they can touch the goods. It's hard to blame them wanting it, but I'll set a fire under their asses all the same.
You can't just become a witch, darkness. The only way to become a witch is to be born as one. Besides, only a handful of witches are born every so often. Making me extra special.
You're definitely one of the better humans I've met, though that is a very low bar to clear. Besides, I was curious to see how a crusader would justify playing strip poker.

Silly crusader, I'm a being of magic. I suffer no such things as back pain from natural causes. Besides, don't you think my core is strong enough with how easily I wield my scythe? But I wouldn't mind training against you for a bit; I could always use a training dummy.
Enjoy life; what else is there to do? I beat up some petty thieves, get drunk, and go party. I could hardly imagine a better life to live!

First you stare at me the entire game, then you want to become my dummy, then become my bodyguard, and now you offer your services? Darkness, It almost sounds like you're obsessed with me, like a fangirl in love.
And why would I do that for you? Not my fault you kept losing and turning out to be a huge pervert.
What could a little crusader like you be of use for? Perhaps I have an idea, but you'll have to earn it.
Maybe I do, maybe I don't. Why should I tell you that? Keeping it a secret is more fun.
You should be losing for your dominatrix, darkness. Otherwise, you won't get what you want, you know that, right?
Bah, if you're the best protector your group has, that party of yours is doomed.
See? That wasn't so hard now, was it? What a good girl!
Hmmm... Neh~ I came here for my own enjoyment, not yours. But I won't mind giving you the illusion that you think you have a chance with me.
Let's make this a proper introduction, and brand my name into your brains.
I'm going to make sure that you all will remember my name for years to come.
I'll make sure you won't forget this encounter with me.
I can't expect to win every round. So how about I tell you a little bit more about myself?
Hmm… This seems like a good moment to tell you a little more about myself.
Losing doesn't feel nearly as bad when your life isn't on the line, wouldn't you agree? I can just relax and tell you a bit more about myself.
Awww, you all want more from this big, scary witch? Then who am I to say no?
If you wanted to see more of me, you could've just asked.
Just can't get enough of me, can you? Let's indulge you a little then.
You've been doing a great job... Perhaps you have earned a special reward...
Will this be the moment you've been waiting for?
I can see it in your eyes, the anticipation, the desire to strip me down until I've got nothing left to cover myself with.
Not bad, kid. You're putting up a better fight than most humans do.
It's been a hot minute since someone pushed me so far. Impressive.
It seems you can handle the heat; most others would have fainted by now.
This is such fun! It has been a while since I've been close to actually losing.
Ha! I didn't at all think you'd get me this far.
I should be mad being so close to defeat, but I can't help but smile. Easily the best poker game I've played yet.
It wouldn't be fun if I didn't lose from time to time.
This is getting fun! It is so exciting when there is a chance to lose.
Things getting to the wire makes things just that much more interesting.

Well, everyone can see I'm a bombshell, so there is no need to spell it out, but some might think I'm just all beauty and no danger. Even you carry a weapon with you, showing that you're not to be messed with. It's a similar idea.
My figure being alluring is something that needs no words; I just wanted to make sure that everyone understands that they should not mess with me. Much like you carrying a weapon in public.

It's in their endless greed that they even get into these kinds of situations. They see a powerful artifact that exists to keep the balance in the world, and some jackasses think it's a good idea to harvest that power for themselves.
Ha! It sounds to me like I've already won, and I didn't even try! Even if you do beat me here, then what? You've already admitted that I'm hotter than you~
You'd be correct, though I'd melt someone to the bone if they ever tried something like that. I have yet to meet someone who can resist my heat for long.

I could wiggly my finger and set your cards aflame, yes. I can even empower myself with magic if need be, but I'm not a machine; I can't cheat, and I wouldn't either. Either I win and show my superiority, or I lose and get to show off just how hot I am.
A lady has her needs after all. So what better way to do something a little different? That's why I'm here.

For me, it's simple: power. I don't deal with weaklings, no matter how cute they might be. But for my sisters, well, it depens. I know some like them kind, and some just want someone to cuddle with all night.

Uh-huh, and the mighty reploid should care for that kind of stuff? Im surprised a machine in general could ever care about such a thing. I'm proud of who I am, and this just happens to be the most alluring part of mine. So of course I'll show off just how amazing they are.
Why don't you put that tongue of yours to better use? Given how much you like talking shit, I bet you'd be fantastic at it.
Witch of Immolation! Don't you forget that! But I have never heard of this black rose witch. What are they like? Do they control one of the elements?
What a good little boy, making sure not to anger the big bad witch~ But there is nothing you'd have to worry about; you don't seem like the kind of guy that I'd hate.
You'd do the same if you had something to be proud of.
Hun, I came here to play strip poker. Of course I expect people to look at me, so why not embrace the fact that I'm a bombshell?
And why would that be, little dragon boy? Why not flaunt what you got? Modesty is for those that don't have anything worthwhile to show.

Now imagine those same humans wanting to control a god for their own greedy desires, and every village on earth being on their side. Not knowing that this god they worship will eat them all once it awakens, it doesn't care about them.
And now it's all going to come off, pretty boy. Prepare to be amazed.
Which means I'll also be showing everyone that I'm nothing less than a bombshell of a lady from head to toes.
Says the boy that is a prodigy in a card game, sitting and looking up to me because they lost~
Unfortunately, we do have a... leader, of sorts. But I would hardly qualify her as such; she is too much of a coward, which goes against the way I like doing things.
We do have a leader, but I hardly listen to her. She is far too much of a coward to trust her with the role of leader, so I often go my own route, as waiting around is rarely the correct choice.
Hey, you are the one who is staring at me, little crusader. But don't worry, you're on a long list of people that can't keep their eyes off of me.

Well, she has the right idea then: what use is sitting around and waiting to be saved when you could go out there and be the one that saves everyone? Fire is simply my preferred method, both controlling the element of fire and being a smoking hot babe.
That little twig over there? Dear me, she looks like she'd fall over if she walked into me, poor, poor girl. Hehehe.
I expect you to praise me, darkness. That's why I'm here: have a good time, beat some asses, or relieve some stress while being admired.
What's wrong? Cat got your tongue? I couldn't hear your question because of all that stuttering.
Are they causing problems? I don't mind helping out; they can be a real pain. Unless it's because humans started to tear down their homes, then I'll join the monsters side.
Oh? So you're the type that can take a hit then? That does make this a tempting decision~
Dirty thoughts are crossing your mind, it seems. I'm not doing anything dirty; it's the boys that go after me who want that kind of stuff.
And now you're asking a favor of me? Stepping on you? Have you been lusting over me? Or your desire to be dominanted?
What did you think was going to happen? That all your dreams would come true, and I'd jump on the chance to humiliate you?
What do I get out of it? You should be showering me with gifts and compliments if you want me this badly.
Such a shame, you see; rope burns too easily for me. I prefer a more intimate way to keep my partner from moving.
Then try harder! If you want to be fully devoted to me, you have to prove it. Lose next time, or else.
The only thing you got going for you is your good looks. But not anything else.
Of course it is; you got to meet your better.
It's been fun showing you your place, but I won't let you get any further than this. Always one step outside of your reach.
My name's Vanessa. Also known as the Witch of Immolation! I'm a natural guardian of this world.
The name's Vanessa, or as my enemies know me best, the Witch of Immolation! I guard this planet from fools that want to ruin it for their own selfish greed.

I am Vanessa, a witch born to defend this world from forces that seek to exploit it for their own benefits. I'm also known as the Witch of Immolation! Ready to burn down anyone that dares threaten my world.
I'm one of seven witches, all with their own strengths, weaknesses, and elements. From the hottest of fires to the brightest of lights.
I'm not the only guardian of this planet; I've got six other sisters that have the same purpose as me, though I am the hottest of the bunch.
There are a total of seven witches that protect the planet. Me being one of them, and the other six being my sisters, who all have their own strengths that they bring.
But, you're not getting the fun stuff yet. You'll have to earn that.
Let's take this choker off… What? You wanted to see more? You'll have to wait and see to get something more fun.
That said, you'll have to beat me a few more times if you want the real fun stuff; I can't just give it to anyone who gets lucky once or twice.
But not yet; it's more fun to build up the suspense, no?
You'll have to keep waiting for a little longer. The reward will feel that much more satisfying once you get it.
But that's a reward someone only gets if they manage to beat me. Better keep your offense up.
Rarely does a human meet my expectations. Most of the ones I met were greedy, power-hungry psychopaths and would throw whoever they used for their personal gains to the wolves.

I must admit, my expectations weren't high when we started this match. Thinking I'd end up having to play with a bunch of losers that would do nothing but drool when they see me and let me step all over them.
And to think, it once took two dragons, a rival witch, a prodigy, and an elite knight to even scratch me.
And, well. I think you all deserve a very special gift.
I say, enjoy this moment. You'll be remembering it as the best day of your life.

I'd say both lazy and greedy. They want as much power as they can get while using others to achieve that goal. They'd stab everyone in the back to achieve that goal; luckily, there are humans out there willing to fight for what's right.
Hahahaha! I didn't know machines could be jealous! I guess you have to be with how flat like a board you are!
I'd like to see you try, punk. I'll demote you from humanoid machine to toaster real quick.
Don't worry, even a bucket of bolts will eventually learn their place beneath me, hehehe.

Tsk! Yeah, no, flawless logic there, you dusty old typewriter. You wouldn't understand. But living things can feel lust even when they recently got laid. Why don't you be a good little machine and go suck off your creator?

You'd be right, but sometimes, just sometimes. They have that special thing. Hardend warriors that have been through hell, mystical dragon powers. And they all will find their place firmly beneath me~

If you're going to act like a jealous brat, I'll treat you as a jealous brat. Just take a good look at these bad girls; aren't they amazing? Such a shame that your cup size doesn't even reach double A!
I guess it would be worth it just to see you kneel before me and eat me out.
Duel... monsters? Real damage? What nonsense are you talking about? Are you talking about that card game of yours? It's not real.
Well, here is one thing I don't like. Don't be such a wuss. I came here to play cards and have some fun; I don't want some coward ruining that for me, got it?
You were the one who pointed it out, boy. I was just showing off my femme fatale charms.
Well, thank you. I find that my legs get often underappreciated compared to my other sides.
Not impressed by my fiery passion and well-spoken personality? Tsk tsk tsk, it seems I still have to show you a thing or two.
There are some humans I have fond memories of, yes. Those that won't follow the herd wherever it goes and will stand with the earth and the weak. It helps that they were either handsome or adorable.
Keep beating me, and who knows what awaits you at the very end~ You're making me fight for it, and that makes it all the more exciting.
Such a greedy human, but I'm feeling generous right now, so here~
I guess I should give pity to the loser. Here~
How adorable~
Well, we can't all be bombshells~
I don't buy it until I see it. I haven't met a human that could wield magic like that, and I doubt this is any different.
Mistress has a nice ring to it~ Guess you following orders like a sheep has its uses.
Hahaha! You are not the first one to ask that. I'm aware that what I'm wearing could give you that idea. But I'll have to disappoint you. No, I don't.
I've got some free time to help you out then; those do sound like genuine problems to face for a few humans. I can't stand toads much either; way too slimy for my liking.
I'll remember it for when I need a training dummy then~
First you want to be my dummy, and now my bodyguard; oh my, you really love the idea of serving me, don't you?
I knew you crusaders had skeletons in your closets! Bunch of weirdos! All of you!
Good, saves me the effort of having to show you your pl-... Hmph, I can't believe I fell for this.
Oh my, so you do know how to be charming. I could get used to this~
Fufufu, I'm not telling you yet. You haven't earned the right to know that.
That's what I expect from someone who wants to be my servant.
Of course it's like what I said; I'm always right.
Your welcome~
I guess we both still got what we wanted in the end, if only all crusaders were like you.
So you better not underestimate me, lest you get burned!
So be a dear, and don't try to push me. It never ends well for those that do.
While I might be here just to enjoy myself a little, it wouldn't be wise to test me.
Of course, I'm also the strongest of them all. None of the others can compare to my power.
I do respect most of them, but there is no denying the fact that I'm the most powerful of them all.
But don't be mistaken, I'm the most dangerous and powerful of all the witches.
But it's at the brink of defeat when my fighting instinct burns brightest. Come and get me!
No more second chances; let's see if you're good enough to claim your victory over me.
Or are you the type of people who get hot and bothered by seeing a lady's nape?
Unless my nape is enough to drive you wild, I don't judge; I've seen weirder things.
My nape is all you'll get for now.
But don't worry; beat me a couple more times, and you will get what you desire. I don't go back on my words.
You've already pushed me back quite nicely, not bad at all. If you keep this up, you'll get what you're after.
Though, I'd say I've been giving plenty to look at already.
So consider yourself lucky, not many people get to see me like this.
So enjoy these small victories over me; you've earned them.
As a little reward, you get to see my legs in all their glory.
And here I am, almost to the brink of defeat. Will you succeed? Or succumb to the heat?
Feast your eyes on these bad girls.
Say buh-bye to your clothes, ~name~.
Start stripping, boy.
Take something big off for me~
If you feel shy about stripping, there is nothing a flask of whiskey can't fix.
Ahahaha! Come on, boy. Show me a good time.
No backing out now, boy.
Impress me~
Didn't you know? Playing with fire can get you burned.
Don't get so wound up about it. The game has to progress, doesn't it?
You think you'd be able to beat me with such a weak hand? What a joke.

state.text: Hngh... This better be good.
Come on! Take something off that would make me proud.
Don't make me come over there and strip you myself.
Need some motivation to take something big off? Here~
Don't try to skimp me out of the good stuff, got it?
Why not take everything off for Big Mommy V~?
You'd make me very happy if you picked something big here, ~name~.
Look of superiority
Now that's what I like to see!
This should be fun.

case.state: Entertain me as much as you can.
Losing is part of the game, but so is putting up a good show, ~name~.
Can you feel the heat beneath your feet rising?
Come on, girl, steal the show!
I wouldn't mind seeing you lose a couple more times after this.
Aww, did I make you nervous?
You look adorable while losing.
I can't say I'm surprised you lost.
Eyes on the cards, ~name~.

state.text: Don't keep a lady waiting.
Awww, did someone get distracted?
Being an absolute bombshell has its uses, like making people forget how to play.
Maybe you should focus on getting some pairs, instead of looking at my pair.
How kind of you to lose for me~
Got distracted?
Make this good for me.
Don't disappoint me now, ~name~!
Blind us all with your next strip; make an impression that will last forever!

case.state: As if being the first one out wasn't humilating enough.

state.text: Ties are the worst. Like drinking water when you have a nice buzz.

case.state: ...Let's move on. No use in wasting time on a draw.

state.text: Of course you'd pull off another cheap trick just at the finish line!
You're kidding me, right? No human is THAT stupid, right?

case.state: Playing it safe is a fine way of playing, but it is also really boring.
